    "E2 [remaining required T23 native evidence] The new production-interface tests close the offline persistence/retry, delayed-import tenant binding and cleanup-recovery portions of prior E2. Acceptance: retain source/build-bound native evidence using synthetic data with the relevant remote fixtures stopped: launch, read saved cases, author/save a local case, relaunch still offline and verify it remains available. Reconnect and establish that no scan, catalog import or remote mutation is replayed automatically. The existing core failure/retry tests need not be duplicated natively.",
    "E3 [unresolved validation failure] docs/planning/evidence/C12/mutation-probes/results.json and probes.log record exit 101 and passes=false for the unmodified library_observation baseline. Acceptance: retain baseline stdout/stderr, explain the failure and provide a healthy unmodified baseline against the restored, frozen inputs under the mutation run's configuration. If a test is flaky, resolve its cause; distinguish actual assertion kills from unrelated failures before crediting affected mutation results."
  ],

    "Prior R1-R5 are addressed by the inspected source and retained tests: Runtime payload refusal, unknown ratios for inconsistent totals, durable library cleanup with placement locking, deadline-driven snapshot publication, and save/copy outcomes reported after persistence with explicit retry. No remaining concrete application defect was established in this re-review; missing and contradictory validation evidence prevents the full gate.",
    "Prior E1 is closed by C12-N10's production NSOpenPanel/NSSavePanel path, including save/import, cancellation, bounded-file refusal, private output and focus return. These overlap. All ten current C12 native assertions report pass on executable 339a61046565d5c339c020d8aa6980863007571f342b730a640f018c3f57a813. Historical C01-C11 records embedded in the C12 evidence directory are not counted as fresh cumulative acceptance on this executable.",

Producer-side refusal and persistence behavior were assessed through source tracing and retained Rust tests; I did not rerun Rust/full frontend suites or operate the native application.",
